columns.name: whtaxbaseamt

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	PurPaymentCode,
	Date,
	UserCode,
	PurInvCode=:ai_purinvcode,
	NetAmt,
	OutstandingAmt,
	AliasName = (SELECT A.AliasName FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = PurPayment.AccCode),
	AccCode ,
	NTN = (SELECT S.NTNNo FROM Supplier S WHERE S.SuppCode = PurPayment.AccCode),
	Posted,
	PostedBy,
	PostDate,
	
	PaymentMode,
	PaymentAccCode,
	PaymentAmt,
	PaymentCheckNo,
	PaymentRemarks,
	
	WHTaxAccCode,
	WHTaxPerc,
	WHTaxBaseAmt,
	WHTaxAmt,
	WHTaxCheckNo,
	WHTaxRemarks,

	GLVochCode
FROM 
	PurPayment
WHERE 
	PurPaymentCode = :ai_code
